bosch-wgg244a1au-good-guys.reason: 9kg front loading with automatic liquid-detergent dosing; the washer to assess for the Bosch stack below.
bosch-wgg244a1au-good-guys.fit: Allow rear space for hoses. Bosch specifies a 600 mm niche only beneath a continuous worktop secured to the adjoining cabinets.
bosch-wgg244a1au-good-guys.tradeoff: Allow 1,073mm with the door open plus usable loading space. Dosing needs the right settings and cleaning; a stacked dryer and kit cost extra.
bosch-wgg244a1au-good-guys.decisionLabel: 9 kg front loader · 636 mm deep with door closed

lg-wx3-1208w-good-guys.reason: 8kg loads where front-to-back space is limited and the dryer can go elsewhere.
lg-wx3-1208w-good-guys.fit: The 635 mm includes the 535 mm closed-door depth and 100 mm rear gap. Allow more for projecting taps or hoses. The open door extends 1,015 mm from the back of the washer.
lg-wx3-1208w-good-guys.tradeoff: The width includes 20 mm each side. This model cannot take a stacking kit.
lg-wx3-1208w-good-guys.decisionLabel: Shallow front loader · allow 640 mm wide × 635 mm deep

lg-wtx3-09g-good-guys.reason: 9kg loads and top access, with no benchtop or dryer above the washer.
lg-wtx3-09g-good-guys.fit: Allow at least 630 mm across (590 mm body plus 20 mm each side) and 100 mm behind the 645 mm body. Measure to the underside of the lowest shelf.
lg-wtx3-09g-good-guys.tradeoff: Check that you can reach the bottom of the drum.
lg-wtx3-09g-good-guys.decisionLabel: Top loader · allow 1,339 mm for the open lid

bosch-wqg24201au-laundry-fit-good-guys.reason: A separate 9kg heat pump dryer for floor-standing use or the documented Bosch stack.
bosch-wqg24201au-laundry-fit-good-guys.fit: 598mm wide; 648mm deep with the door closed.
bosch-wqg24201au-laundry-fit-good-guys.tradeoff: Allow 1,096mm door-open depth and maintenance access. Expect long cycles; budget for the approved kit and fitting if stacking.

bosch-sms6hci02a-good-guys.reason: A full-width freestanding replacement with 15 place settings, adjustable baskets and a separate cutlery tray.
bosch-sms6hci02a-good-guys.tradeoff: Allow 1,155mm door-open depth plus standing room. Check tall items beneath the tray, the cavity and worktop arrangement; no matching cabinet-door installation.
bosch-sms6hci02a-good-guys.decisionLabel: Separate cutlery tray · 845 mm high with worktop fitted

bosch-sps6iki01a-good-guys.reason: A narrow freestanding installation: 10 place settings and an upper cutlery/knife rack, not a full third drawer.
bosch-sps6iki01a-good-guys.fit: With the worktop fitted the body is 450 mm wide, 845 mm high and 600 mm deep. Check the installation drawing against the narrowest point of your opening and leave room for hoses and loading.
bosch-sps6iki01a-good-guys.tradeoff: The narrower baskets take less bulky cookware. Check your largest pan against the rack.
bosch-sps6iki01a-good-guys.decisionLabel: Slimline · 450 mm body, 1,155 mm deep with door open

westinghouse-wtm4302wd-r-good-guys.reason: Top freezer with 329 L of fresh-food space, 21 L more than the LG.
westinghouse-wtm4302wd-r-good-guys.fit: Allow 90 mm above and 50 mm behind.
westinghouse-wtm4302wd-r-good-guys.tradeoff: This model hinges on the right. A corner wall needs 430 mm on that side for shelf removal.

lg-gb-b400ps-fridge-fit-good-guys.reason: Bottom freezer with 128 L for frozen food. A 700 mm opening is 5 mm too narrow.
lg-gb-b400ps-fridge-fit-good-guys.fit: Allow more than 50 mm behind the 696 mm deep fridge.
lg-gb-b400ps-fridge-fit-good-guys.tradeoff: Check overhead clearance, door swing and drawer access.

bosch-wqg24201au-good-guys.reason: 9kg heat pump for regular, larger loads where energy use matters more than quick cycles.
bosch-wqg24201au-good-guys.tradeoff: Allow 1,096mm door-open depth and maintenance access. Higher upfront cost, long cycles and filter/heat-exchanger care; not wall mountable.
bosch-wqg24201au-good-guys.decisionLabel: Frequent loads · 648 mm deep with door closed

electrolux-edv605h3wc-good-guys.reason: 6kg vented for smaller, occasional loads when a suitable exhaust arrangement is available.
electrolux-edv605h3wc-good-guys.fit: 600mm wide × 795mm high × 560mm deep body; installation needs more space.
electrolux-edv605h3wc-good-guys.tradeoff: Smaller capacity, two-star energy rating and moist exhaust. Confirm installed depth, ventilation, fitting and any optional vent kit before comparing total cost.
electrolux-edv605h3wc-good-guys.decisionLabel: Occasional loads · check ventilation and wall fixings

tgg-gap-integrated-smv4htx01a.reason: A matching furniture door and hidden controls, with 14 place settings and a lower cutlery basket.
tgg-gap-integrated-smv4htx01a.fit: Allow at least 550 mm of cabinet depth and 1,155 mm with the door open. The matching front panel is a separate purchase.
tgg-gap-integrated-smv4htx01a.tradeoff: Have the installer check panel weight, kickboard clearance, fixing points and hoses.
tgg-gap-integrated-smv4htx01a.decisionLabel: Fully integrated · 600 mm wide × 815–875 mm high opening

tgg-gap-haier-hrf510fhs.reason: French doors, a lower freezer drawer and a refillable water tank.
tgg-gap-haier-hrf510fhs.fit: Haier specifies a cavity 850 mm wide, 1,775 mm high and 757 mm deep.
tgg-gap-haier-hrf510fhs.tradeoff: Check that both doors can open and the freezer drawer clears the island.

westinghouse-wtm3100wl-x-good-guys.reason: Top freezer with 238 L for fresh food and 74 L for frozen food.
westinghouse-wtm3100wl-x-good-guys.fit: Allow 90 mm above and 50 mm behind.
westinghouse-wtm3100wl-x-good-guys.tradeoff: Beside a corner wall, the hinge side needs 350 mm for shelf removal.

westinghouse-wsf6602xc-good-guys.reason: A simpler 14-place full-width option with six programs and a lower cutlery basket.
westinghouse-wsf6602xc-good-guys.fit: The drawing specifies a cut-out 580 mm deep. The body is 598 mm deep, so the front can project beyond the cabinet. Allow 1,175 mm with the door open, plus space to load it.
westinghouse-wsf6602xc-good-guys.tradeoff: A lower cutlery basket takes up some plate space.
westinghouse-wsf6602xc-good-guys.decisionLabel: Cutlery basket · 600 mm wide × 850 mm high cut-out
